text:
rachel_fin: Heads-up: Helion Analytics (acct HA-4419) flagged for non-payment. 2 invoices outstanding total $29,400, oldest 47 days. Collections reports client says their payments team paused payments after an internal audit and wants to push ACH from a new bank. Theyre disputing a $1,400 usage line on INV-20240718 and asking for a one-time credit + portal unlock to pay. @ivy_support @mark_sales can we triage?

billing-bot: System note: invoices: INV-20240718 ($15,200), INV-20240610 ($14,200). Last payment: $0 in 2024. Status: PAST_DUE. Collections vendor: Cedar Collections, outreach started 2024-08-22.

tom_collections: Client has been slow to respond on calls. Recommending short hold while finance engages, but need a firm commitment date or we resume dunning. They've mentioned getting legal involved if pushed.

ivy_support: I can open a 30-minute portal unlock window after we verify bank docs and run fraud checks. Workflow: create support ticket, verify KYC, then run `/unlock-portal --acct=HA-4419 --window=30m --by=ivy_support`. Uploads must go to secure intake: https://vault.redwood/payments-upload (no channel DMs).

mark_sales: My suggestion: offer provisional credit for the disputed $1,400 to avoid escalation, plus ask for 50% payment during unlock and remainder in 30 days. I'll handle comms if finance approves.

rachel_fin: Finance policy: provisional credits up to $2,000 can be applied by ops. We'll mark disputed amount in GL until reconciliation. If we provisionally credit, need signed 14-day reconciliation acknowledgement.

cecil_cfo: Approve provisional credit of $1,400 conditional on: 1) client uploads bank letter + voided check OR completes micro-deposit verification within the 30m window; 2) client signs the 14-day reconciliation & payment commitment; 3) collections paused until 2024-09-01 COB. Add account note: "PROV_CREDIT_1400_CECIL_2024-08-23". No payment plan >30 days without CFO approval.

ivy_support: Creating ticket SB-94011 now. Will run KYC checks and stand by for docs. Will attach fraud logs to the ticket and only run unlock after verification.

mark_sales: Reaching out to client now with the offer and instructions for upload. CC collections & finance.

tom_collections: Pausing outreach until 2024-09-01. If we don't get signed ack/payment, resume escalation 2024-09-02.

rachel_fin: I'll prepare the provisional credit entry and mark AR with reserve code MR-AR-PROV. Update SB-94011 when docs arrive. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
